newsitem.title: GREECE: INFORM LYKOS LAUNCHES NEW DIGITAL PRINTING FACILITY.
newsitem.headline: INFORM LYKOS LAUNCHES NEW DIGITAL PRINTING FACILITY.

text.p: Greece's high-tech printer Inform Lykos inaugurated its expanded digital printing and inserting facility at its plant in Koropi.

"By the year 2004 some 70 percent of information will be disseminated electronically and only 30 percent on printed paper compared to the current 10 versus 90 percent," said managing director Nick Lykos.
The company will form a joint venture with Dutch concern Proforms B.V. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
